projects.title: Neuroviewer
projects.description: 3D web-based visualization platform for neuronal structure files
projects.extendedDescription: A sophisticated 3D web viewer designed for visualizing SWC and E-SWC files containing three-dimensional neuronal structures. This application enables researchers to load datasets from multiple sources including GitHub repositories, Google Drive, and local uploads. The intuitive interface supports dynamic manipulation with zoom, pan, rotation, and toggle controls. Key technical achievement involved implementing Google Cloud API integration with domain restriction to limit Google Drive access exclusively to UCLA-affiliated accounts.

projects.title: Rabies Input Diagram
projects.description: Interactive single-page application for rabies input signal visualization
projects.extendedDescription: An advanced interactive diagram application featuring layered SVG visualizations converted to PNG format through custom Python scripting. Users can dynamically toggle individual layers and adjust opacity levels while maintaining full zoom and reset capabilities. The application implements intelligent resource management by loading low-resolution images initially and dynamically switching to high-resolution assets based on zoom level, optimizing browser memory usage and preventing performance bottlenecks.

projects.title: Brain-ception
projects.description: Comprehensive internal management platform for UCLA B.R.A.I.N research
projects.extendedDescription: A full-stack web application serving as a centralized management system for hundreds of study cases, research projects, neuronal reconstructions, and image processing workflows. This mission-critical resource significantly enhanced operational efficiency for the UCLA B.R.A.I.N research center. The primary technical challenge involved orchestrating parallel image processing jobs across distributed servers at UCLA's BMAP center, achieved through Prefect workflow orchestration software and custom local APIs.

projects.title: Zeppelin
projects.description: Volunteer time tracking and management system for UCLA B.R.A.I.N
projects.extendedDescription: A comprehensive full-stack application for tracking volunteer hours, schedules, project assignments, and activity notes. Features dedicated administrator dashboards with aggregated metrics and oversight capabilities. Successfully adapted to evolving client requirements through iterative development, incorporating Google Calendar integration, advanced administrative tools, and comprehensive volunteer performance analytics.

projects.title: Spinalcord Interface
projects.description: Microscopy channel visualization interface for spinal cord research
projects.extendedDescription: A specialized single-page application developed for the Cell Atlas of Mouse Brain-Spinal Cord Connectome grant, providing detailed connectivity mapping through multiple counter-staining channels. This project served as an introduction to modern front-end frameworks and established foundational skills in scientific visualization web applications.

projects.title: Screen Zlash
projects.description: Product launch landing page for mobile application
projects.extendedDescription: A collaborative front-end project developing a complementary landing page for a jointly-developed mobile application. Focused on creating an engaging user experience that effectively communicated the app's value proposition and features.

projects.title: Helen's Studio
projects.description: Multi-service e-commerce platform for creative services
projects.extendedDescription: A comprehensive online storefront managing photography services, merchandise, and catering operations. Implemented robust CRUD functionality with real-time calendar synchronization. The booking system features automated email confirmations and dynamic calendar updates based on client availability and response status.

projects.title: Pythonic Projects
projects.description: Collection of image processing and analysis utilities
projects.extendedDescription: A comprehensive suite of Python scripts and utilities supporting advanced image processing workflows for UCLA B.R.A.I.N research. Capabilities include region segmentation, resolution scaling, bit-depth conversion, image cropping, metadata extraction, and format transformation. These tools have become essential resources for the research team's daily operations.

projects.title: ATN Interactive Diagram
projects.description: Interactive neural connectivity mapping for ATN brain region
projects.extendedDescription: A specialized wiring diagram application visualizing input and output connections within the Anterior group of the dorsal thalamus (ATN). Users can interact with connection pathways to isolate individual or grouped neural pathways. Technical challenges included converting Adobe Illustrator assets to SVG format and implementing dynamic styling systems to meet complex client visualization requirements.

projects.title: Sav3
projects.extendedDescription: A price comparison tool developed for UC Merced's UX development course that aggregates product pricing from major online retailers including Amazon, BestBuy, and Newegg. The application features sorted results and comprehensive product comparisons. Successfully resolved CORS header limitations through implementation of a custom proxy service to enable cross-domain data aggregation.
